name: Depth Alignment for Monocular Cues
definition: Aligning monocular depth estimates (range [0,1]) with rendered depth by solving for scale and shift parameters per mini-batch via least-squares optimization.
summary: Depth Alignment for Monocular Cues resolves scale and shift ambiguity in NeRF training by linearly aligning monocular depth estimates with rendered values per mini-batch, differing from multi-view methods by using single-view consistency.
